narrative.offerRewardText: Thanks again, adventurer.  Here are your tickets!
narrative.requestItemsText:
adventurer, the attraction I'm designing will be the scariest event since Gnomeregan was overrun! And it's largely thanks to you and all the baubles you've brought me. Many, many thanks!

I don't need much else, but... if you bring me more evil bat eyes from the bats of the Eastern Plaguelands... I might have more Darkmoon Faire tickets for you.
